summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Xtrackers MSCI Kokusai Equity ETF (KOKU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI Kokusai (World ex Japan) index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of large- and mid-cap developed market stocks outside of Japan. KOKU was launched on Apr 8, 2020 and is issued by Xtrackers.

holdings.infoBox: KOKU is an equity ETF with a total of 1105 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 5.98%, Apple at 5.79%, Microsoft at 4.21%, Alphabet at 4.17%, and Amazon.com at 2.79%.
